visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with long brown hair stands centrally in a modern kitchen environment. She wears a plain white oversized t-shirt featuring a "CHINA DOLLS" graphic. She looks directly at the camera with a wide smile and expressive eyes, using large hand gestures to emphasize her speech. The background features white cabinetry, a stovetop, and various kitchen utensils hanging on the wall. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of her manicured hands holding a transparent plastic bag containing a round, white dessert. She points to the blue heart-shaped logo on the label. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the plastic and the product inside. She flips the package around to show different text and details on the back. (3) The character holds up a small, rectangular instructional card titled "簡易食譜" (Simple Recipe). The card displays color-coded sections for "Air Fryer" and "Grill" processes with small illustrations of the food item. She points to the specific temperature and time settings listed on the card while maintaining eye contact with the camera. (4) A white Philips brand airfryer is shown in a medium close-up on the kitchen counter. The character's hand enters the frame to rotate the silver control dial and press digital touch buttons. The display glowingly shows "200°" and "5 min" in amber digits. The lighting is focused on the device's sleek surface and interface. (5) The drawer of the airfryer is pulled open, revealing a black internal basket. She carefully places a bread-enclosed ice cream treat onto a piece of parchment paper inside. She slides the drawer back into the main unit with a firm motion, her bracelets clinking slightly. (6) The camera focuses on the digital timer of the airfryer as it counts down. A yellow text overlay "200°" and "5分鐘" appears briefly. The shot transitions to show the timer hitting zero, indicating the completion of the cooking process. (7) She takes out the finished product, which now has golden-brown, toasted edges. She holds it on a white napkin and takes a large, enthusiastic bite. Her facial expression shows immediate satisfaction. A split-screen graphic appears briefly comparing "Air Fried" and "Deep Fried" versions. (8) A macro close-up shot shows the interior of the bitten sandwich. A thick, solid layer of light green ice cream is visible, contrasted against the thin, crispy outer layer of white bread. The texture of the cold filling and the toasted bread is clearly defined under the bright studio lights. (9) In the final segment, she continues to eat and speak happily. She waves one hand towards the camera and sways her body slightly from side to side. Yellow captions appear at the bottom of the screen. The kitchen remains tidy and brightly lit in the background.

The BGM remains steady, maintaining the positive and lively atmosphere of the tutorial while emphasizing the texture of the fried ice cream. There is no other incidental noise, and the signal-to-noise ratio remains excellent during this enthusiastic conclusion.
